cohort: Women aged 20 to 45 years who conceived through either donor-oocyte IVF (n=78) or self-oocyte IVF (n=112) between 2010 and 2016.
finding: While perinatal outcomes were similar, miscarriage, first-trimester bleeding, pregnancy-induced hypertension, and gestational diabetes mellitus were significantly higher in the donor-oocyte IVF group.
